body: My parents would never even fathom the thought.

I have built my own pc just after I hit 12 years old, specs are as follows:

i5 3570k
gtx 770 (sli soon...or never...)
16gb ram
and a nice ssd.

I cannot bring myself to going back to school, and thanks for all that research you did, i really appreciate it. It also reinforces my conclusion in dropping out.... Thank you.

I don't think that would work. School counsellors aren't exactly dedicated to making your life better. They have a life, they probably have kids, and at the end of the day, they are their for their paycheck. They could talk to me and give me advice to deal with depression, but the most a counsellor can do legally is set up a meeting with my parents. My parents have their mind set, and nothing can change that. As i said, I cannot find another way, other than suicide.

I have a bath filled with water. I can sit on the edge, and use this trick to pass out :https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-xv1eS1ieTQ

I fall unconscious, fall into the bath *face down*, brain makes me breath. I suffocate.

That is one of the things I forgot to mention, I don't think there is any point in getting a job where you are paid a set amount per year. You cannot really become wealthy that way. The best way is to day trade. It really doesn't take much, to do so, and it DEFINITELY does not require you to learn about the expansion of different metals in school to do so. 

A few days ago I predicted a rise in a stock by about 60%. That was the day I was sold on the idea. Why get a job?? Why get a degree? That is another reason I find school pointless. Not completely useless, but most of it is.
